proposals.title: Compact twin-lobed muzzle flash
proposals.change: Add a short-duration, camera-facing twin-lobed muzzle flash proxy to the primary aircraft gun firing point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small additive sprite or card, warm white core with restrained amber edge, 0.05-0.09 second lifetime, and bounded size relative to the weapon muzzle.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive emissive content stays in the muzzle region and cannot create a dark FOV wall or sun-washout field.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Combat and ADS; muzzle flash is readable for one burst, occupies less than 3 percent of frame area, and all 11 cameras remain Usable.

proposals.title: Muzzle flash pulse ring
proposals.change: Add one thin emissive pulse ring expanding from the gun muzzle during firing.
proposals.implementation_notes: Drive ring scale and opacity over a sub-0.12-second curve; keep the ring narrow and below full-frame bloom thresholds.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The effect is localized to a single small emissive contour and adds no opaque or dark geometry.
proposals.acceptance_test: Verify the ring reads as a firing cue without obscuring the nose silhouette or crossing more than 5 percent of the image width.

proposals.title: Thin gun smoke ribbon
proposals.change: Add a sparse, pale-gray gun smoke ribbon trailing briefly behind the muzzle after firing.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use translucent pale gray with low opacity, narrow ribbon width, short 0.3-0.5-second lifetime, and no volumetric wall behavior.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Pale, low-opacity additive smoke avoids the prohibited dark smoke wall while preserving aircraft silhouette visibility.
proposals.acceptance_test: Smoke remains visibly thin, never fills a central quadrant, and does not reduce contrast on Prop, PropNose, YakBeauty, City, Ocean, or Wide.

proposals.title: Gun smoke puffs
proposals.change: Add two small separated post-shot smoke puffs at the muzzle exit.
proposals.implementation_notes: Spawn no more than two puffs per shot, use pale neutral gray, low opacity, and staggered scale curves so the effect remains airy and localized.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Separated small puffs add event detail without forming an opaque mass or dark silhouette blocker.
proposals.acceptance_test: In the Combat capture, each puff is distinct, remains within 1.5 muzzle lengths, and leaves the background and aircraft readable.

proposals.title: Directional hit spark fan
proposals.change: Add a short directional fan of bright hit sparks at the aircraft impact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit each burst to 6-10 fine streaks, bias emission away from the surface, and cap brightness and length for capture stability.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Fine additive streaks are spatially bounded and create no opaque or dark coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Sparks read at the impact point, remain shorter than the visible fuselage width, and do not cause clipping or bloom washout.

proposals.title: Single impact ember core
proposals.change: Add one compact orange-white emissive ember core at the first hit location.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small billboard with a brief brightness peak and fast fade; keep the radius below the local panel feature scale.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single tiny emissive point provides a stable focal cue and cannot obscure the nose or create a smoke wall.
proposals.acceptance_test: The ember is visible in PropNose and Combat, remains under 1 percent of frame area, and does not alter silhouette readability.

proposals.title: Drone explosion flash core
proposals.change: Add a compact two-stage emissive flash core for a drone destruction event.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a white-yellow core followed by a restrained orange shell, with total visible duration below 0.35 seconds and no opaque debris volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The explosion is a small additive focal event with bounded radius and no dark volumetric body.
proposals.acceptance_test: The flash reads as a drone event in Combat and City, stays below 4 percent of frame area, and introduces no sky washout.

proposals.title: Drone explosion ember scatter
proposals.change: Add a sparse ring of warm emissive embers after the drone explosion flash.
proposals.implementation_notes: Spawn 8-12 small embers with short lifetimes, low bloom, and a tight radial extent around the destruction point.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Sparse bright embers preserve negative space and cannot become a dark or full-frame effect.
proposals.acceptance_test: Embers are individually distinguishable, stay within two drone lengths, and do not overlap the aircraft hero silhouette excessively.

proposals.title: Low-density flak puffs
proposals.change: Add three small pale flak burst puffs along a short defensive-burst path.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep puffs small, pale gray, and separated by visible sky or ocean gaps; disable dark smoke accumulation and cap active bursts.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Separated pale accents add scale and activity without introducing a dark flak wall or broad occlusion.
proposals.acceptance_test: Three puffs remain separated in City and Combat, each under 1.5 percent of frame area, with no measurable loss of hero visibility.

proposals.title: Flak spark pinpoints
proposals.change: Add a few bright pinprick sparks inside each flak burst.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use 3-5 tiny white-orange points per burst, short lifetime, and tightly bounded spread inside existing flak positions.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Pinpoint additive sparks remain small at distance and cannot create a blocking cloud or wash out the sky.
proposals.acceptance_test: Sparks are visible as discrete points in Wide without becoming a continuous bright band or affecting City composition.

proposals.title: Prop wash crescent
proposals.change: Add a thin translucent-emissive crescent indicating prop wash behind the aircraft.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a pale blue-white crescent with low opacity and a narrow arc, aligned behind the prop hub and clipped to a compact radius.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The crescent is localized to the prop region, additive, and pale enough to avoid blackening or sky washout.
proposals.acceptance_test: Prop wash reads as a subtle airflow cue, stays behind the prop silhouette, and does not reduce hub or nose detail.

proposals.title: Prop wash filament streaks
proposals.change: Add two short emissive filament streaks following the prop wash direction.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use two narrow curved streaks with low opacity and subtle motion; place them behind the prop hub and keep their length below one hub diameter.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Two narrow additive accents increase local edge structure without forming a large airflow volume.
proposals.acceptance_test: Filaments remain behind the hub, are visible in both target cameras, and cover less than 2 percent of either frame.

proposals.title: Forward tracer pair
proposals.change: Add a pair of thin warm-white tracer streaks extending from the muzzle toward the target direction.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use two tapered lines with orange tips, short travel distance, and restrained intensity; terminate them well before broad background coverage.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Thin additive lines create directional detail while preserving the aircraft, city, ocean, and sky fields.
proposals.acceptance_test: Tracers are legible as two separate lines, remain below 8 percent of frame width, and do not cross the hero cockpit or nose focal region.

proposals.title: Single tracer tip glow
proposals.change: Add a compact emissive glow at the leading tip of the primary tracer.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one small warm-white billboard with a fast pulse and low bloom, parented to the tracer tip rather than the camera.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The glow is a single tiny additive point and cannot create a wall, dark field, or broad washout.
proposals.acceptance_test: Tip glow is visible at the tracer head, stays below 1 percent of frame area, and does not clip against HUD-safe framing.

proposals.title: Short missile trail ribbon
proposals.change: Add a narrow pale emissive ribbon behind the missile for a short travel segment.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a pale gray-blue ribbon with a soft warm core, short maximum length, and no dark smoke component; taper opacity rapidly behind the missile.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The ribbon is thin, pale, additive, and length-limited so it cannot become a dark smoke wall or cover the wide scene.
proposals.acceptance_test: Trail reads in Combat and Wide, stays under 4 percent of frame area, and does not form a continuous horizon stripe.

proposals.title: Localized ocean spray fan
proposals.change: Add a small fan of bright ocean spray at a single near-aircraft water impact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use 5-8 short pale-blue-white streaks with low opacity, tightly localized footprint, and no opaque foam volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A compact additive spray fan enhances one water event without darkening or flattening the ocean field.
proposals.acceptance_test: Spray is localized to one impact, remains below 3 percent of frame area, and leaves the horizon and water texture readable.

proposals.title: Water splash crown
proposals.change: Add a small emissive-edged splash crown at the existing water contact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low, broken crown with pale cyan highlights and transparent gaps; keep the crown radius below the local wake width.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Broken additive highlights preserve water gaps and prevent the splash from becoming a solid horizon or black mass.
proposals.acceptance_test: Crown remains low and broken, reads against the water in both cameras, and does not intersect the main aircraft silhouette.

proposals.title: Harbor splash droplets
proposals.change: Add four isolated emissive droplet streaks above a harbor splash contact.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep droplets narrow, pale blue-white, and separated; use randomized but bounded lengths and a short lifetime.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Isolated droplets add fine-scale movement without creating a dense spray field or obscuring harbor geometry.
proposals.acceptance_test: All four droplets remain individually separable, stay within one splash radius, and do not cover buildings or the aircraft.

proposals.title: Ocean spray glint points
proposals.change: Add three tiny cool-white glint points to the tops of the ocean spray particles.
proposals.implementation_notes: Parent glints to existing spray peaks, keep their intensity below sun-disc levels, and use a short pulse with no additional volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Three low-intensity points add readable spray highlights without introducing broad high-energy emission or washout.
proposals.acceptance_test: Glints remain smaller than the aircraft nose at capture resolution and do not merge into a bright strip in Ocean or Wide.

proposals.title: Layered tracer-to-splash cue
proposals.change: Add one short tracer segment ending in a compact water-splash spark cue at a distant impact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single thin warm tracer with a small pale-blue splash endpoint; keep both effects short, additive, and spatially separated from the aircraft hero.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Both components are tiny additive proxies with bounded extent, no dark smoke, and no broad sky or ocean coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: The tracer and splash read as one distant event, occupy less than 5 percent of frame area combined, and preserve Ocean, Wide, City, and Combat usability.
